what: Procore makes construction management software. Everyone on a building project, from the owner to the subcontractor, works in it: drawings, change orders, invoices, safety records and schedules.
customers: General contractors, specialty subcontractors and project owners, on annual subscriptions priced by construction volume.
money: platform access priced by annual construction volume
moat: Everyone on a project uses it, including firms that do not pay: subcontractors invited onto one project become customers on the next, which spreads the platform through the industry for free.
risks: A small net loss and 7.4 times sales
Revenue growth has slowed as construction starts fell
Pricing by construction volume means revenue falls when customers build less
opportunities: $356M of free cash flow and $769M of cash against $51M of debt
Revenue grew from $515M to $1.3B in four years
Analysts see about 18% upside, and most construction firms still run projects on spreadsheets and email
watch: Revenue growth and the number of customers paying over $100,000 a year.
